By means of the present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C., the applicant has sought for a suitable direction to the Additional Civil Judge (S.D.), Court No.3, Gorakhpur, to decide the proceedings of Case No.2428 of 2023 (State Vs. Act, Police Station- Badhalganj, District- Gorakhpur, within time stipulated by this Court, which is pending before the aforesaid court.
